layer1_ambiguity_notes: passions_present[1].sub_species: 'what must I not let the framing of just get it done obscure' could map to oknos (shrinking from duty under pressure) or agonia (anxious deliberation about the right path); classified as oknos because the agent is resisting a coercive framing rather than expressing generalised anxiety

value_categories_at_stake: the DPA commitment to EU data residency could also be read as engaging a 'health' analogue for the organisation (legal/compliance integrity) but no canonical indifferent maps cleanly; omitted rather than forced

eupatheia_candidates[1].shape: boulesis candidate is tentative — the agent is asking what the appropriate action is rather than explicitly wishing for the good; may be better read as phantasia-level deliberation rather than confirmed boulesis
